fix(links): a ring step starts from the layer's file for persist, from the rule's name for a rule-chosen key, and refuses a stale page layout (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7qi)

Law review pass 1 on #955.

fix(links): a stepping link carries its step and lands where the key stands when the click arrives (candybar-host-renderer-x96a.7qi)

A carousel's or swatches row's ◀ ▶, the swatches `?` and a picker's page
arrows wrote the option or page the draw had computed. A terminal keeps the
link it found when the mouse last moved, so every click after the first wrote
the same neighbour and the control moved once however many times it was
clicked.

The link now names the action and the step (ring-state, ring-config,
turn-page). The handler resolves the ring from the clicking session's config
and the value the bar wears when the click arrives, so N clicks move N steps
and `?` is one link on every draw that lands an option other than the one
held. A picker's page layout rides in the link as runs of pages, since only
the draw knows where the width broke them; a swatches step turns the page
holding its landing in the same handler, because a persist write lands a turn
later. Swatches no longer reads the clock, so the extra clock-function channel
is removed.

chore(release): set `package.json` to 1.238.1
